solution:
**Calculation:**

The total value of proficient is 20 + 25 + 25 + 33 + 34 = 137

The total value of Below basic is 40 + 19 + 41 + 34 + 8 = 142

The total value of Basic is 35 + 45 + 29 + 21 + 5 = 135

The total value of Advanced is 5 + 11 + 5 + 12 + 52 = 85
